title: Disability Compensation Payment Calendar
content:
Disability Compensation is paid monthly in arrears. The calendar values below are the same for every tier, from Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating).

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Issue day | Day 1 of the month following the entitlement month, moved to the prior business day when it falls on a weekend or federal holiday |
| Payment start lag | 1 month after the month containing the effective date; payment begins the first day of the following month |
| Lead time for a payment-account or delivery-method change | Recorded at least 10 calendar days before the payment's issue date |
| Payment for the month in which the veteran dies | Released to the surviving spouse |

**Illustrations (hypothetical dates)**

- The payment for the entitlement month of March is issued on 1 April; if 1 April were a Sunday, it would be issued on the last business day before it.
- For an increase effective 12 May, the month containing the effective date is May, so the first month paid at the new rate is June, issued on 1 July.
- For a payment issued on 1 July, a new bank account recorded on 21 June is 10 calendar days before the issue date and applies; one recorded on 22 June is 9 days before and does not.
